description: Game stores and clubs on SGL near a place, optionally ones that run a game: address, opening hours, phone, the games they list, their next public events and their calendar feed.

distance.description: How far to look (default 25 miles or 40 km).

near.description: A town, address or postal code, e.g. "Provo, UT" or "84604". Leave out to use the signed-in player’s saved area.
